#!/usr/bin/env python3
import uno
from com.sun.star.beans import PropertyValue
from com.sun.star.awt import Rectangle
from com.sun.star.table import CellRangeAddress

def make_prop(name, value):
    p = PropertyValue()
    p.Name = name
    p.Value = value
    return p

# Connect to running LibreOffice
localContext = uno.getComponentContext()
resolver = localContext.ServiceManager.createInstanceWithContext(
    "com.sun.star.bridge.UnoUrlResolver", localContext)
ctx = resolver.resolve(
    "uno:socket,host=localhost,port=2202;urp;StarOffice.ComponentContext")
smgr = ctx.ServiceManager
desktop = smgr.createInstanceWithContext("com.sun.star.frame.Desktop", ctx)

# Load the file
url = "file:///home/user/BoomerangSales.xlsx"
load_props = (make_prop("Hidden", False),)
doc = desktop.loadComponentFromURL(url, "_blank", 0, load_props)

# Get Sheet1
sheets = doc.getSheets()
sheet = sheets.getByName("Sheet1")

# Find data range - get cursor for used range
cursor = sheet.createCursor()
cursor.gotoStartOfUsedArea(False)
cursor.gotoEndOfUsedArea(True)
used_range = cursor.getRangeAddress()
print(f"Used range: rows {used_range.StartRow}-{used_range.EndRow}, cols {used_range.StartColumn}-{used_range.EndColumn}")

# Number of data rows (excluding header)
last_row = used_range.EndRow
last_col = used_range.EndColumn
n_rows = last_row + 1  # total rows including header
n_data_rows = last_row  # excluding header

# Sort by column A ascending
# Range includes header
data_range = sheet.getCellRangeByPosition(0, 0, last_col, last_row)

# Use sort descriptor
sort_fields = []
from com.sun.star.util import SortField
sf = uno.createUnoStruct("com.sun.star.util.SortField")
sf.Field = 0  # column A (0-indexed)
sf.SortAscending = True
sort_fields.append(sf)

sort_desc = data_range.createSortDescriptor()
# Modify properties
new_sort_desc = []
for prop in sort_desc:
    if prop.Name == "SortFields":
        prop.Value = uno.Any("[]com.sun.star.util.SortField", tuple(sort_fields))
    elif prop.Name == "ContainsHeader":
        prop.Value = True
    new_sort_desc.append(prop)

data_range.sort(tuple(new_sort_desc))
print("Sorted")

# Now create a line chart
# Charts collection on the sheet
charts = sheet.getCharts()

# Position chart to the right of data
# Each cell ~ 2000x500 in 1/100 mm by default; let's use a reasonable position
# Place chart starting at column H (col 7), row 1
# Get cell H2 position
chart_cell_start = sheet.getCellByPosition(7, 1)  # H2
chart_cell_end = sheet.getCellByPosition(15, 20)  # P21

start_pos = chart_cell_start.Position
end_pos = chart_cell_end.Position
end_size = chart_cell_end.Size

rect = Rectangle()
rect.X = start_pos.X
rect.Y = start_pos.Y
rect.Width = (end_pos.X + end_size.Width) - start_pos.X
rect.Height = (end_pos.Y + end_size.Height) - start_pos.Y

# Data range for chart: column A (Date Time) and column E (Quantity)
# We'll use two ranges
range_a = CellRangeAddress()
range_a.Sheet = 0
range_a.StartColumn = 0
range_a.StartRow = 0
range_a.EndColumn = 0
range_a.EndRow = last_row

range_e = CellRangeAddress()
range_e.Sheet = 0
range_e.StartColumn = 4  # column E (Quantity)
range_e.StartRow = 0
range_e.EndColumn = 4
range_e.EndRow = last_row

chart_name = "QuantityLineChart"
# Remove if exists
if charts.hasByName(chart_name):
    charts.removeByName(chart_name)

charts.addNewByName(chart_name, rect, (range_a, range_e), True, True)
print("Chart added")

# Now change the chart type to Line
chart = charts.getByName(chart_name)
embedded = chart.getEmbeddedObject()
diagram = embedded.createInstance("com.sun.star.chart.LineDiagram")
embedded.setDiagram(diagram)
print("Chart type set to Line")

# Save the document as xlsx
save_props = (make_prop("FilterName", "Calc Office Open XML"),
              make_prop("Overwrite", True))
doc.storeToURL(url, save_props)
print("Saved")

doc.close(False)
print("Done")
